value.rationale: The antipodal kernel is a canonical maximum-distance Green response. Its exact and growing number of sign changes measures a genuine fourth-order resolvent positivity obstruction, while the final crossing has a quantitatively sharp log-squared dimension scale distinct from exponential semigroup smoothing. The all-dimensional finite sign classification is a motivated natural invariant, even without a complete full-matrix positivity theorem.
